keyPoints.en: Find key words from the question in the passage.
keyPoints.hi: प्रश्न के मुख्य शब्द अनुच्छेद में ढूँढो।

keyPoints.en: Inference: use clues to find what is not written directly.
keyPoints.hi: अनुमान: जो सीधे नहीं लिखा उसे सुरागों से समझो।

keyPoints.en: The title often tells the main idea.
keyPoints.hi: शीर्षक अक्सर मुख्य विचार बताता है।

problem.en: "Aman took his umbrella and wore his raincoat before leaving home." What was the weather like?
problem.hi: "Aman took his umbrella and wore his raincoat before leaving home." मौसम कैसा था?

steps.en: Umbrella and raincoat are used when it rains.
steps.hi: छाता और रेनकोट बारिश में इस्तेमाल होते हैं।

problem.en: "The shopkeeper smiled and gave Neha an extra toffee for returning the extra change." Why did he give her a toffee?
problem.hi: "The shopkeeper smiled and gave Neha an extra toffee for returning the extra change." उसने टॉफ़ी क्यों दी?

steps.en: Neha returned money that was not hers.
steps.hi: नेहा ने वह पैसे लौटाए जो उसके नहीं थे।

question.en: What is an answer we work out from clues called?
question.hi: सुरागों से निकाला गया उत्तर क्या कहलाता है?

question.en: "The children shivered and rubbed their hands." What was the weather?
question.hi: "The children shivered and rubbed their hands." मौसम कैसा था?

question.en: What often tells the main idea of a passage?
question.hi: अक्सर अनुच्छेद का मुख्य विचार क्या बताता है?

intro.en: To understand a passage, first read it fully, then read the questions and look back for the answers. Some answers are stated directly; others we must work out (infer) from clues.
intro.hi: किसी अनुच्छेद को समझने के लिए पहले पूरा पढ़ो, फिर प्रश्न पढ़ो और उत्तर के लिए वापस देखो। कुछ उत्तर सीधे लिखे होते हैं; कुछ सुरागों से अंदाज़ा (अनुमान) लगाना पड़ता है।
